title: Zapier examples: Ways to use automation at work
summary: When you want to get more done and have more impact at work, automation can help. Get ideas on how to automate forms, notifications, email, customer support, and more.
body_markdown:
When you want to get more done and have more impact at work, automation can help. Zapier helps you turn your tools into powerful processes. Whether you need to automate a simple task or build an entire automated system, you can do it all on Zapier.


We've collected some of the best Zapier examples across different industries and roles, so you can find something to help you get more done, no matter what you do at work. Click on any of the headings below to be taken to an in-depth article, or copy a prompt to build the example directly from your AI agent.


Build automations from wherever you work. Describe the outcome you want, and Zapier connects your tools, runs the steps, and stays on the job after you close the chat. Combine AI with reliable, deterministic automation across 10,000+ apps.[Get started for free.](https://zapier.com/sign-up)

## What can you do with Zapier?


Zapier connects 10,000+


apps, so work can move between them without you copying and pasting. Every automation is a Zap, an automated workflow that starts when something happens in one app (like a new form entry), or on a schedule (like every Monday morning). It then does the work in your other apps. Zaps use AI only for the steps that need judgment—like deciding whether a message is a sales lead—and run everything else the same way every time.


You can build Zaps directly from your AI assistant. Add Zapier as a connector or a custom MCP server, then connect the apps you use, like Gmail, Slack, and Google Sheets. Just connect once—the same connections work from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or any AI tool you like. Describe the job in plain language, and your agent drafts the Zap and deploys it to Zapier, which keeps it running whether or not your laptop is open. Or build it in Zapier itself, starting from a template or the Zap editor.


[Try Zapier](https://zapier.com/)


## Zapier examples


Start with the team or job closest to yours. Each heading below links to an in-depth article on that area, and each prompt is something you can paste into your AI assistant once Zapier is connected, then adjust to the apps you use.


### [Popular Zaps](https://zapier.com/blog/popular-zaps/)


These are some of the most-used automated workflows people set up with Zapier, covering things like social media, task management, note-taking, feedback collection, and reminders.


### [Project management](https://zapier.com/blog/project-management-automation/)


Project management is all about keeping everyone working together. Automation can streamline task creation, communication, and more by automatically creating tasks and sending custom notifications—no matter what apps you're using to get work done.


Say a deal closes and nobody remembers to kick off the work. A Zap can start the moment the deal moves, so the project exists before the handoff email is sent.


**Try asking:**


Prompt


```text
Build on Zapier: When a deal moves to Closed Won in HubSpot, create a project in Asana from my onboarding template and assign the kickoff task to the account owner.
```


**Learn more:**[How to use Zapier and AI to streamline project management](https://zapier.com/blog/streamline-project-management-with-ai/)


### [Email](https://zapier.com/blog/email-automation/)


Just about everyone uses email for something, but that means you can end up with more going on in your inbox than you can easily manage. Automation can help you keep things organized and on track.


Your agent can draft a reply in chat, but a Zap is what notices the new email, labels it, and logs it while you're away from your desk.


**Try asking:**


Prompt


```text
Build on Zapier: Label each new email in Gmail by intent, like support, sales, or invoice, and send me a digest in Slack at 5 p.m.
```


If your inbox is under control, check out these ways to automate your[email marketing](https://zapier.com/blog/automate-email-marketing/) .


### [Contact forms](https://zapier.com/blog/automate-contact-form/)


Contact forms are an easy way to get information from your prospects and customers. Move faster by adding automation to your processes so your team gets notified of every new lead or contact.


Leads go cold when a form entry sits in an inbox. A Zap starts when the form is submitted, so the right person hears about it right away.


**Try asking:**


Prompt


```text
Build on Zapier: When someone submits my website contact form, add them to HubSpot, post in #leads in Slack, and email them a confirmation. If the message mentions pricing, mark it high priority.
```


### [Sales and CRM](https://zapier.com/blog/crm-automation/)


Keep your pipeline current without anyone doing data entry. Zaps can create the contact when a lead arrives, update the deal when a stage changes, and ping the owner when a deal goes quiet.


**Try asking:**


Prompt


```text
Build on Zapier: When a new lead arrives from Facebook Lead Ads, add them to HubSpot, summarize their answers with AI, and message the assigned rep in Slack.
```


### [Marketing](https://zapier.com/blog/marketing-automation-use-cases/)


From the first signup to the follow-up, Zaps can move leads between your forms, ad platforms, email tools, and CRM, so campaigns run without a weekly copy-and-paste ritual.


**Try asking:**


Prompt


```text
Build on Zapier: When someone signs up for my webinar, add them to a Mailchimp list, tag them by the campaign they came from, and add a row to my tracking sheet in Google Sheets.
```


### [Finance and invoicing](https://zapier.com/blog/streamline-invoicing-with-zapier/)


Invoices, receipts, and payment alerts tend to pile up. Zaps can log each one where your books expect it and flag the ones that need a person.


**Try asking:**


Prompt


```text
Build on Zapier: When a payment fails in Stripe, add a row to a Google Sheet with the customer and amount, and send my finance channel in Slack a message.
```


### [IT and ops](https://zapier.com/blog/automate-it-management/)


Routine requests don't need a person to move them along. Zaps can open the ticket, notify the on-call owner, and keep an audit trail in a spreadsheet.


**Try asking:**


Prompt


```text
Build on Zapier: When someone fills out the new-laptop request form, create a Jira ticket, assign it to IT, and post a note in #it-help.
```


### [AI workflows](https://zapier.com/blog/ai-by-zapier-guide/)


Some jobs need judgment, like sorting a message or summarizing a call. Zaps can add an AI step only where it's needed and keep every other step the same each run.


**Try asking:**


Prompt


```text
Build on Zapier: When a new support email arrives in Gmail, use AI to decide if it's a bug report, a billing question, or a feature request, then create the right task in Asana and reply with a confirmation.
```


### [Note-taking](https://zapier.com/blog/automate-note-taking/)


Turn your ideas into action by adding automation to your note-taking. With Zapier, you can create tasks from notes, automatically create documents for new meetings, organize your ideas, and create backups.


**Try asking:**


Prompt


```text
Build on Zapier: When I star a note in Evernote, create a task for it in Todoist with a due date of tomorrow.
```


### [eCommerce](https://zapier.com/blog/ecommerce-automation/)


If you're selling online there are opportunities for automation, from sharing new products on social to customized sale (and failed sale) notifications.


A failed order or a big refund is easy to miss in a busy store. A Zap can catch it the moment it happens.


**Try asking:**


Prompt


```text
Build on Zapier: When a Shopify order fails or a refund is over $100, log it in a Google Sheet and alert me in Slack.
```


### [Social media](https://zapier.com/blog/social-media-marketing-automation/)


No matter where your audience is—or how you're using social media—automation can help you move faster and have greater impact. From crossposting to tracking to brand monitoring, Zapier makes it easier.


**Try asking:**


Prompt


```text
Build on Zapier: Whenever we publish a new blog post, draft a LinkedIn post that summarizes it. Then, save it in Buffer for me to review.
```


### [Files and folders](https://zapier.com/blog/organize-files-with-automation/)


Organization is key to efficiency. Automation can upgrade your organization strategies by helping you save attachments, create an archive of favorite social media posts, back up your important work, and create folders and files for new projects.


**Try asking:**


Prompt


```text
Build on Zapier: Save every invoice attachment that lands in Gmail to a Dropbox folder named by vendor and month.
```


### [Human resources](https://zapier.com/blog/human-resources-automation/)


Automate HR processes like recruitment, training and onboarding, and team support to free up your time to focus on the people you work with—not processes.


**Try asking:**


Prompt


```text
Build on Zapier: When a new hire is added in BambooHR, create their setup checklist in Asana, invite them to Slack, and remind their manager about day one.
```


### [Meeting management](https://zapier.com/blog/meeting-management/)


Meetings can take up a surprising amount of time. Let automation be your assistant, keeping you on time and prepared with automated agenda creation, customized alerts, and better task management.


**Try asking:**


Prompt


```text
Build on Zapier: After each Google Calendar meeting ends, create a Google Doc for the notes and send the attendees a thank-you with a link to it.
```


### [Real estate](https://zapier.com/blog/real-estate-automation/)


From generating leads to managing client relationships to keeping yourself organized, automation works in the background so you can keep things moving forward.


**Try asking:**


Prompt


```text
Build on Zapier: When a new inquiry comes in from my website form, add the lead to my CRM, send them our listing packet, and remind me to call within the hour.
```


### [Customer support](https://zapier.com/blog/automation-for-customer-support-teams/)


Your support team has daily contact with your customers. Make their lives easier by adding automation to help keep tickets organized and notifications in line, track responses, and more.


**Try asking:**


Prompt


```text
Build on Zapier: When a Zendesk ticket has been open for 24 hours, post it in #support-escalations in Slack and tag the on-call agent.
```


### [Notifications](https://zapier.com/blog/automate-notifications/)


If your inbox and push notifications are out of control, take back your attention by creating custom alerts.


**Try asking:**


Prompt


```text
Build on Zapier: When a high-value deal is created in Salesforce, send me a Slack message with the deal name, amount, and owner.
```


### [RSS](https://zapier.com/blog/how-to-use-rss-feeds/)


RSS feeds are great for keeping track of new posts, changes to a site you follow, or for setting up customized notifications or summaries. Enhance your productivity by using RSS feeds with automation to streamline information.


**Try asking:**


Prompt


```text
Build on Zapier: When a new post appears in my industry's RSS feed, summarize it with AI and add it to a Slack channel I share with my team.
```


### [Video](https://zapier.com/blog/video-automation/)


You've put the effort into creating a quality video. Make sure you're set up to get the most value from it. Automation helps you create an archive, promote across platforms, create transcriptions, and more.


**Try asking:**


Prompt


```text
Build on Zapier: When I upload a new video to YouTube, post it on LinkedIn and add a row to my content tracker in Google Sheets.
```


### [Backups](https://zapier.com/blog/backup-everything/)


Everyone knows they *should* back up their files, but actually following through can be a task that's easy to put off. Let automation manage this for you.


**Try asking:**


Prompt


```text
Build on Zapier: Every Friday, copy the files I changed this week in Google Drive to a backup folder in Dropbox.
```


### [Zapier Tables](https://zapier.com/blog/zapier-tables-guide/)


Store, edit, share, and automate data all in one tool.


[Get more prompt templates](https://zapier.com/blog/zapier-ideas/)


## Zapier examples FAQs


### What can you do with Zapier?


Zapier lets you automate work across 10,000+


apps. A Zap starts when something happens in one app, or on a schedule, and then does the work in other apps. People use Zaps to log new leads in a CRM, route email, create tasks when a deal closes, alert a team when an order fails, and keep files organized. You can ask your AI assistant to build a Zap for you, or build it in Zapier yourself.


### What are some of the best Zapier automations?


The best ones take work you do over and over and run it for you: adding every new form entry to your CRM, posting new leads to Slack, creating a project when a deal closes, saving email attachments to a folder, or alerting you when a payment fails. Start with the example above closest to your day, copy the prompt, and adjust the apps to the ones you use.


### Can I build Zaps with AI?


Yes. Add Zapier to your AI assistant, connect your apps, and describe what should happen. Your agent drafts the Zap and deploys it to Zapier, which runs it after the chat ends. Zaps use AI only for the steps that need judgment, like sorting a message, and run everything else as regular steps. If you'd rather build it yourself, you can do that in Zapier too (still using plain language).


### Which big companies use Zapier?


Teams at Lowe's, Samsung, NVIDIA, Meta, Mastercard, Shopify, and Dropbox use Zapier.


### Why is Zapier so popular?


Zapier is popular because of its ease of use, connectivity, and track record. Zapier has been managing app connections for 15+ years, and anyone in an organization can build directly from their AI assistant—across 10,000+


apps. Once a Zap is built, Zapier runs it without human intervention. If something breaks, Zapier finds the problem and proposes a fix you can approve, or applies fixes on its own if you let it.
